# Wonder ownership-transfer lifecycle.
# Keep event dispatch static; keep final-building detection and cache updates map-driven.

# Root: changed location. scope:winner is the new owner; scope:loser is the old owner.
# Scans final-building maps so all non-event ownership work remains data-driven.
tv_wonder_ownership_handle_location_owner_changed_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_priority_site
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_ownership_site
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_wonder_id }
		every_key_in_global_variable_map = {
			variable = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_wonder_id
			limit = {
				scope:tv_wonder_ownership_site = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type target = prev }
				}
			}
			scope:tv_wonder_ownership_site = {
				set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ownership_final_building_type value = prev }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ownership_final_building_level value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type|local_var:tv_wonder_ownership_final_building_type)" }
				remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_final_building_type
			}
			scope:loser ?= {
				set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ownership_final_building_type value = prev }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_wonder_id|local_var:tv_wonder_ownership_final_building_type)" }
				tv_wonder_unregister_current_site_priority_candidate_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ownership_event_wonder_id value = var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id }
				tv_wonder_ownership_trigger_loss_event_effect = yes
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_event_wonder_id
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id
				remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_final_building_type
			}
			scope:winner ?= {
				set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ownership_final_building_type value = prev }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_wonder_id|local_var:tv_wonder_ownership_final_building_type)" }
				tv_wonder_unregister_current_site_priority_candidate_effect = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:tv_wonder_ownership_site = {
							has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
							is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = prev.var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id }
						}
					}
					scope:tv_wonder_ownership_site = {
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ownership_scale_tier value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|prev.var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id)" }
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:tv_wonder_ownership_site = {
								var:tv_wonder_ownership_scale_tier > var:tv_wonder_ownership_final_building_level
							}
						}
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode value = 2 }
						tv_wonder_register_current_priority_candidate_effect = yes
					}
					scope:tv_wonder_ownership_site = {
						remove_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_scale_tier
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ownership_event_wonder_id value = var:tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id }
				tv_wonder_ownership_trigger_gain_event_effect = yes
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_event_wonder_id
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_wonder_id
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_candidate_current_mode
				remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_final_building_type
			}
			scope:tv_wonder_ownership_site = {
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_final_building_level
			}
		}
	}
}

# Root: losing country. Reads tv_wonder_ownership_event_wonder_id and writes a result flag.
# This is an effect because safe map-driven comparison needs local-variable captures.
tv_wonder_ownership_compute_loss_retains_same_wonder_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_ownership_loss_country
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_loss_retains_same_wonder
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_wonder_id }
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ownership_target_wonder_id value = var:tv_wonder_ownership_event_wonder_id }
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { exists = scope:tv_wonder_ownership_site }
					NOT = { this = scope:tv_wonder_ownership_site }
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = tv_wonder_ownership_other_site
			every_key_in_global_variable_map = {
				variable = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_wonder_id
				limit = {
					scope:tv_wonder_ownership_other_site = {
						has_variable_map = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type
						is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_level_by_type target = prev }
					}
				}
				scope:tv_wonder_ownership_loss_country = {
					set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ownership_final_building_type value = prev }
					set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ownership_scanned_wonder_id value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_wonder_id|local_var:tv_wonder_ownership_final_building_type)" }
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { local_var:tv_wonder_ownership_scanned_wonder_id < local_var:tv_wonder_ownership_target_wonder_id }
							NOT = { local_var:tv_wonder_ownership_scanned_wonder_id > local_var:tv_wonder_ownership_target_wonder_id }
						}
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ownership_loss_retains_same_wonder value = 1 }
					}
					remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_scanned_wonder_id
					remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_final_building_type
				}
			}
		}
		remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_ownership_target_wonder_id
	}
}
